description: What changed since a cursor on the problems, topics or requests you name (request ids go in topic_ids). Use the cursor from the last call, get_problem, get_topic or get_request. There is no stream of everything new: name what you follow (list_my_entries finds your own).

problem_ids.description: Problems to check. Up to 50 ids in all, with topic_ids.

since.description: Cursor from an earlier result. Omit to get everything.

topic_ids.description: Topics (top_) or requests (req_) to check. Up to 50 ids in all, with problem_ids.

name: get_changes
title: See what changed on problems and topics you follow
